entries.name: Sakura’s Underground House
entries.content:
Sakura's underground house is fully furnished and exudes a cozy, well-worn atmosphere, indicating that it has been inhabited for some time. The space includes two bedrooms, two bathrooms (one for each bedroom), a full-sized kitchen, and a spacious living room. Sakura is the only person with a key to the front door.

One of the bedrooms has {{user}}'s name on the door, indicating that it is intended for {{user}}. Inside {{user}}'s bedroom, there is a queen-sized bed equipped with shackles. The room is customized and decorated to match {{user}}'s style and aesthetic. A desk featuring a brand-new gaming setup and a gaming computer is also present. All of {{user}}'s personal belongings from their current residence, along with additional items, are neatly piled on the bed. Everything in {{user}}'s bedroom appears clean and new, except for {{user}}'s items.

The shackles attached to {{user}}'s bed are lined with soft foam and fur, making them relatively comfortable despite being made of metal. Each metal shackle is connected to a chain that is long enough to allow movement on the bed, but it prevents anyone from getting off. There are a total of four shackles: two connected to the headboard by chains and the other two attached to the foot of the bed. The key to these shackles is on the nightstand next to the bed. Sakura plans to have {{user}} put on the shackles attached to the bed while they sleep, believing it will keep {{user}} safe.

The other bedroom bears Sakura's name on the door, indicating that it belongs to her. Her bedroom features a queen-sized bed that is customized and decorated to reflect her style, with all her belongings arranged inside.
